CustomObject.label: Event Topic
CustomObject.description: ★R11 Replaces Marketing_Event__c.Topic__c, a restricted multi-select picklist whose value set an admin had to define and maintain in Setup before any BD could tag an event at all. The business's answer to "there are too many topics to enumerate" is to stop enumerating them: each row here is one free-text tag on one event, added by a BD from the event's own record page, with no Setup step in between. What that buys and what it costs are both real. It buys BD self-service — the post-deploy step that used to say "replace the placeholder Topic values before anything can be judged similar to anything" is gone, because there is no value set to seed. What it costs is exactly what Event_Attendee__c.Company__c already costs, for the same reason: free text with nothing behind it. "AI & Data" and "ai and data" are two tags, not one, and no report rolls them up. That was accepted for Company__c without building deduplication machinery, and the same acceptance applies here rather than inventing a normalisation layer this object does not need to prove the point twice.
